Travel Notice for Companion Animal Flyers

Travelers should check their pet papers and crate plans before reaching the gate.

Aurelia Skyways asks you to keep your documents ready and speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk if anything has changed. Staff will note updates in the desk ledger and share clear guidance with the crew so the trip stays smooth for everyone. <<FACT F082>> For birds, please make sure the crate meets the published size rules and stays secure, with room for safe standing and turning. <<FACT F071>> If you are traveling with a rabbit or bird, bring the needed items early and follow the packing notes from the desk.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk is here to help you finish each step with confidence and calm. Companion Animal Travel Desk
